title: Aurora Research — Memory, Knowledge and Context Architecture
selection_policy: Official implementations and primary research for material technical claims; recent papers are treated as emerging evidence with explicit limitations.

sources.title: Observational Memory: 95% on LongMemEval
limitations: Vendor-authored evaluation
Primarily conversational benchmark
Does not establish project authority, operational state or physical memory

sources.title: Inside OpenAI’s in-house data agent
supports: live runtime validation when stored information is stale
limitations: Describes a bespoke internal data agent
Does not publish full implementation or benchmark suite
Domain differs from personal engineering/laboratory Aurora

sources.title: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
supports: need to keep personal memory current
limitations: Product-level description rather than full architecture
Does not establish evidence/authority semantics for engineering projects

sources.title: Letta (formerly MemGPT)
limitations: Repository/product semantics are not Aurora semantics
Current feature behavior requires version-specific verification

sources.title: Letta Code — The memory-first coding agent
supports: multiple interaction channels and remote environments
limitations: Coding-agent focus
Self-described capabilities require independent evaluation
Does not define Aurora authority/device model

sources.title: Agent File (.af)
supports: separation of history, system prompt, memory blocks and tools
limitations: Format support is implementation-specific
Serialization does not guarantee semantic equivalence or security

sources.title: From Storage to Experience: A Survey on the Evolution of LLM Agent Memory Mechanisms
limitations: Recent preprint
Survey framework rather than an Aurora implementation proof

sources.title: Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents: Mechanisms, Evaluation, and Emerging Frontiers
limitations: Recent survey preprint
Synthesizes heterogeneous systems and benchmarks

sources.title: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents
supports: integrity, confidentiality, availability and governance objectives
need for provenance, versioning and policy-aware retention
limitations: Recent survey preprint
Formal recommendations require implementation-specific validation

sources.title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
supports: evaluation of static/dynamic state, workflow, gotchas and premise awareness
limitations: Web-agent environments differ from Aurora
Reported methods and results need reproduction for selected models

sources.title: When Stored Evidence Stops Being Usable: Scale-Conditioned Evaluation of Agent Memory
limitations: Recent preprint
Results depend on tested agent, memory interface and budgets

sources.title: Supersede: Diagnosing and Training the Memory-Update Gap in LLM Agents
supports: supersession as a distinct memory failure
memory size alone does not resolve current-value selection
need for explicit evaluation/training of updates
limitations: Very recent preprint
Training result is preliminary and does not select an Aurora mechanism
